title: Events Log Entry v1.0
description: Unified events log schema — replaces provenance-log + work-log. One row/file = one event. Three kinds: 'provenance' (pipeline ingest/normalize/project/validate/cascade — every MCP response or SF file produces one entry, append-only, run_id monotonic per project), 'work' (DONE protocol §21.4 step 4 emits these into logs/work-done/{YYYY-MM}/{task_id}.json — 10 closed event_type subtypes, monthly-report aggregates last-28-day events), 'audit' (governance placeholder — Phase 14+ for permission/access changes). Discriminator field is event_kind. Common envelope: schema_version, event_kind, event_id, timestamp, project_id. Sub-kind specific fields are defined alongside; conditional requireds enforced via allOf if/then. Cross-kind invariants: agent_run_id on a work event must reference an existing provenance event run_id. Retention: provenance append-only forever; work 12 months active then archive zip (§20.3); audit policy TBD. Both url + url_normalized required on URL-bearing work events (D-S3-5). All hash fields use sha256:hex64 pattern.

event_kind.description: Top-level discriminator. Determines which sub-kind required fields apply. ADR-020: 'workflow' eklendi (workflow lifecycle event'leri için, audit routing workaround yerine semantik-doğru kategori).

event_id.description: Unique per project. For work events convention {event_type}_{task_id}_{timestamp_compact} (e.g. content_new_T-0042_20260420T1030); for provenance events run_id is the aggregator and event_id is per-row; for audit events governance assigns.

project_id.description: Matches project-config.schema.json.project_id. Required across all kinds for portfolio cross-project aggregation (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §26.2).

run_id.description: PROVENANCE-only. Monotonically increasing per project. A single run_id groups all entries produced by one pipeline invocation (e.g. one weekly SF import writes N entries sharing the same run_id).

source.description: PROVENANCE-only. Origin of the data. source.kind determines which nested fields populate.

kind.description: sf_csv → filename_original + filename_normalized + file_hash + row_count; *_mcp → response_bytes + row_count; manual/tool_computed → neither.

source_folder.description: For sf_csv: the ingest folder relative path (e.g. sf_exports/2026-04/).

filename_original.description: Pre-normalization SF filename, Turkish chars preserved.

filename_normalized.description: Post filename_alias normalization (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.4) — ascii + v_/p_ prefix stripped.

response_bytes.description: MCP raw response size; used for storage budget.

mcp_server.description: Short server name (gsc / dataforseo / scrapling) — matches mcp-tool-registry.json.

operation.description: PROVENANCE-only. Pipeline stage (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1 Stage 1-4 + DONE cascade §21.4). 'staging' = Phase 6 D-003 pre-Excel staging routing (raw MCP response → SQLite/JSON staging only, no master.xlsx write; Phase 8+ skills project later). One entry per (file|response, operation) pair.

target_table.description: PROVENANCE-only. Staging SQLite table written to. Convention: {provider}_{subject} (sf_urls, gsc_search_analytics, dfs_keyword_overview, scrapling_competitor_snapshot).

target_excel_sheet.description: PROVENANCE-only. Null when operation=ingest|normalize|validate (no Excel write). Required to be a logicalSheet when operation=project_excel.

cells_written.description: PROVENANCE-only. Projection-mode=kpi_cells writes cells, not rows.

validation_errors.description: PROVENANCE-only. Human-readable error strings; for machine-readable checks use consistency-report.checks[].

cost.description: PROVENANCE-only. Cost accounting for paid sources (DFS credits, etc.). Absent when source.kind is free.

currency.description: ISO 4217, only when billed in money not credits

params_hash.description: PROVENANCE-only. SHA-256 of the exact input params (MCP args, SF filename set). Used as cache key and for re-run determinism check.

file_hash_chain.description: PROVENANCE-only. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §9.4 L2 Hash Chain — hash at each hand-off must match.

row_count_chain.description: PROVENANCE-only. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §9.4 L3 Row Count Chain — raw_lines − 1 (header) == staging_rows.

excel_diff_hash.description: PROVENANCE-only. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §9.4 L7 Diff Verification — pre/post snapshot of target sheet. Only populated when operation=project_excel.

backup_path.description: PROVENANCE-only. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §9.4 L5 Atomic Write — relative path to the pre-op Excel backup. Restored on consistency-RED rollback.

consistency_report_ref.description: PROVENANCE-only. Relative path to the consistency-report.json snapshot written at L6 checkpoint. Links provenance ↔ consistency for audit.

notes.description: PROVENANCE-only. Free text. Distinct from work.note.

event_type.description: WORK-only. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §20.2 — closed 10-value enum. Stored value; display decoration (emoji in reports) applied at render time.

task_id.description: WORK-only. References master_task.task_id. Convention: T-NNNN (zero-padded 4 digits).

url_normalized.description: WORK-only. url after project.config.url_policy normalization (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.6 + §12.2). Used for cross-sheet joins. Both url + url_normalized are required on URL-bearing work events (D-S3-5).

pillar.description: WORK-only. Matches project-config.pillars[].key (e.g. P01_sofa_sets). Required on pillar_launch and content_new with pillar context.

cluster.description: WORK-only. Cluster slug matching data/cluster defs. Required on content_new + quickwin_applied.

metric_impact.description: WORK-only. Measured outcome after the change (optional at event time; back-filled by monthly-report generator §22 from GSC 28-day delta).

author.description: WORK-only. Human name or agent id. For agent runs also populate agent_run_id.

agent_run_id.description: WORK-only. Cross-kind link: references a provenance event's run_id that produced this work event (when automated). Cross-kind invariant — link work ↔ provenance.

work_log_ref.description: WORK-only. Relative path back to this file, duplicated in master_task.work_log_ref (col S §21.1) — kept in-file for self-describing archival.

indexing_ping.description: WORK-only. Optional docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §24 Indexing API ping record. Populated only when user accepted the prompt in DONE cascade step 6.

primary_source.description: WORK-only. Matches master_task.primary_source (§21.1 col C). Copied here so each work event is self-contained for archival replay. Enum 9→11 sync per master-excel ADR-018 additive policy (resolves Q-V1.2-MASTER-TASK-PRIMARY-SOURCE-01 events-side, K-05 v1.4-deep-audit-fix).

related_sources.description: WORK-only. Matches master_task.related_sources (§21.1 col D) — merged-task union. Enum mirrors primary_source (additive 9→11 per ADR-018).

note.description: WORK-only. Free text; required on event_type=manual and event_type=content_remove (to record redirect_from_to target). Distinct from provenance.notes.

attachments.description: WORK-only. Relative paths to supporting files (screenshots, outreach emails, redirect_from_to.txt). Relative to project workspace_root.

audit_action.description: AUDIT-only (placeholder, finalized Phase 14+ governance). What governance action was performed.

audit_target.description: AUDIT-only. Resource path or identifier of the object affected (e.g. schemas/project-config.schema.json, project:{slug}, role:editor).

actor.description: AUDIT-only. Identity that performed the action (user email, agent id, system process).

workflow_action.description: WORKFLOW-only (ADR-020). Workflow lifecycle transition. Logged by workflow_runner.py state machine into events.jsonl.

workflow_run_id.description: WORKFLOW-only (ADR-020). References workflow-run.schema.json $.run_id (string pattern). Distinct from provenance.run_id (integer) to avoid type collision — events.run_id remains integer/provenance-only.

step_index.description: WORKFLOW-only (ADR-020). Zero-based index into workflow-run.steps[] of the step this event refers to. Optional but recommended for correlation.

allOf.description: Per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §20.2: URL-bearing work event types require url + url_normalized together.
content_revise MUST carry both before + after snapshots (§20.2).
content_new + pillar_launch require after snapshot + pillar (§20.2).
redirect_deployed + content_remove + backlink_outreach + manual require note.
quickwin_applied requires cluster + before + after (title/meta change diff).
WORKFLOW kind required fields (ADR-020). workflow_action + workflow_run_id mandatory; step_index optional.

pageSnapshot.description: Minimal page state snapshot. Both before/after share this shape so diffs are trivial. Used by work events; preserved verbatim from prior work-log.schema.json v1.0.

schema_types.description: Schema.org @type values present on the page at snapshot time (e.g. Article, Product, FAQPage).

taskIdPattern.description: Master task ID format. Authority: rules/master-task-id.md. Mirrors master-excel.schema.json#/definitions/taskIdPattern (per-schema replication, ADR-XXX cross-schema $ref deferred v1.5).

sha256Hash.description: SHA-256 content hash with 'sha256:' prefix (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §9.4 hash chain). Used by file_hash, params_hash, intake_hash, staging_hash, pre_hash, post_hash.

slugKebab.description: Project/skill slug. kebab-case lowercase + digits + hyphens (rules/naming.md).

pillarPattern.description: Pillar key matching project-config.pillars[].key (e.g. P01_sofa_sets, rules/naming.md).

workflowRunIdPattern.description: Workflow run ID format ({slug}-{YYYY-MM-DD}-{hash4}, rules/naming.md). Mirrors workflow-run.schema.json $.run_id (per-schema replication).
